Checked the defining header and pinned library meanings, rather than accepting the correspondence explanation. Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/PiL2.lean:113–114 defines EuclideanSpace as PiLp 2, with exponent 2:ENNReal; its dist_eq/dist_sq_eq at 160–166 give the Euclidean sum of squares. PiLp is WithLp of the coordinate function type, its function coercion is ofLp, and WithLp has only the underlying value field, with no assumed geometric property. Fin n is the finite coordinate index, without a nonempty-index requirement. Fin.snoc, castSucc and last append and recover exactly the first n and last coordinates, including n=0. Consequently YF describes precisely coordinate-concatenated E×I in both directions. T003 explicitly requires the distance identity, both inverse identities, projection contractions and surjective line isometry; T004 transports contents, measures and dimension both ways. No default product sup metric is used. Metric.ediam is the ENNReal supremum of pairwise edist, with empty diameter zero. YCover/YCost/YContent/YHaus reproduce arbitrary countable covers, their costs, infima and positive-scale suprema. Empty padding is reversible, and positive exponents make its cost zero. The native hausdorffMeasure_apply formula at Hausdorff.lean:547–552 includes nonempty-member guards and the infinity scale; T001 explicitly bridges these: empty costs vanish and the infinity-scale infimum is bounded by every finite-scale infimum. T002 exports equality plus all four critical-exponent directions. HausdorffDimension.lean:94–111 confirms native dimH is the ENNReal supremum over NNReal exponents of infinite Borel Hausdorff measure. The actual PiLp Borel instance applies to every Fin n. Positive s makes Real.toNNReal/ofReal exact; dimH E is kept extended until T006 establishes finiteness. T016's toReal diameters are finite because YCover bounds them by ofReal δ, and T017 explicitly plans the power/coercion conversions. Native real volume agrees with source Lebesgue integration for the open-set indicators and restricted interval used here; no arbitrary projection is asserted measurable. These are concrete planned bridges, not added H or target-bearing construction fields.
